name: ForexRateAPI
author: forexrateapi

sections.description:
Display live or historical foreign exchange (forex) rates in over 150+ currencies

Use shortcode [forexrateapi] to display foreign exchange rates on your wp website.

Official Website

Shortcode Customization:

  • {{symbol}}
  • {{base}}
  • {{price_round}}
  • {{date}}
  • {{date_format}}
  • {{date_timezone}}
  • {{unit}}

Display Customization:

  • {{base}}
  • {{timestamp}}
  • {{price}}
  • {{symbol}}
  • {{date}}

Detailed instructions included upon plugin installation.

External services

This plugin connects to ForexRateAPI endpoint to obtain real-time foreign exchange rates. It is needed to show the foreign exchange rates in the included widget.

This service is provided by “ForexRateAPI”:

sections.installation:
Upload the extracted plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.

Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress and then enter your forexrateapi.com API key.
sections.changelog:
1.1.8

  • WordPress 7.0 and 7.1 compatibility (tested on WordPress 5.0 through 7.1)
  • PHP 8.4 / 8.5 hardening
  • Fixed a fatal error when the API response did not contain the requested currency
  • Fixed a fatal error when an invalid date_timezone was supplied
  • Unrecognised shortcode attributes now fall back to the “no result” template instead of failing
  • A zero change is no longer shown in the “loss” colour; no movement now makes no colour claim
  • Admin menu now uses a plugin-specific slug, so ForexRateAPI and MetalpriceAPI no longer clash when both are active

1.1.7

  • Version bump

1.1.6

  • Bug fixes

1.1.5

  • Initial release
